name: fred_natural_gas
description:
The Henry Hub natural gas spot price from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series DHHNGSP (dollars per million Btu, daily).
Returns {"series": "DHHNGSP", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): series_id (string; the schema default DHHNGSP is not filled in by the server, so it has to be sent), limit (integer, number of newest observations; omitted: 60, although the schema default says 20).
Related: fred_oil_price; fred_custom_series takes any series id.
Example: {"series_id": "DHHNGSP", "limit": 20}
API key: env FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); when unset the placeholder DEMO_KEY is sent.

series_id.description: FRED series id; the default is this tool's series, which the server does not fill in, so it has to be sent

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
